results.title: Madhuvidhu
results.overview: When Amrutharaj, a groom from an all-male household repeatedly rejected by brides' families, falls in love with Sneha Marcose, their journey toward marriage ignites a chain of hilarious chaos inside his unruly home.

results.title: Cheetahs Up Close with Bertie Gregory
results.original_title: Cheetahs Up Close with Bertie Gregory
results.overview: Bertie arrives in the Serengeti as the spectacular wildebeest migration kicks off. He’s here to film the fastest land animal on Earth: the cheetah. As he gets close to a mother caring for her tiny cubs and a young group of males executing phenomenal hunts as a team, he learns about the unexpected challenges the species endures.

results.title: Scorpion
results.overview: Once a fighter for the cause, a Smuggler is hired by the TD-One Authority to escort a young girl out of the system, only to learn she is the daughter of the woman he once loved and that her existence could change the fate of their world.

results.title: Devour
results.overview: Stranded after a disastrous gig, an all-girl heavy metal band finds a woman in danger in a town ruled by a warlock, and crawling with cannibals, vampires, and a deadly werewolf, forcing them to fight for survival.

results.title: Beijing Ghosts
results.overview: On the night before leaving Beijing, Mo spends her last hours in the city with Bai. When the camcorder disappears, their search leads them into the blind spots of a city that never stops watching.

results.title: Roid
results.overview: A solitary middle aged man marries a madwoman and builds a house on a vacant plot of land far from the village. However, his wife’s madness becomes a calamity in his tranquil life.

results.title: Bohurupi: The Golden Daku
results.overview: A cop tries to track down Bikram Pramanik, a master of disguise whose wife is a pickpocket.

results.title: Subedaar
results.overview: Haunted by loss and drifting away from his daughter, a retired Subedaar Arjun Maurya’s newly found civilian life is jolted by one reckless act. As old wounds reopen, he must summon the warrior within to face a new kind of war - one that hits too close to his heart.

results.title: The Djinn's Curse 2
results.overview: In a village at the foot of Mount Budo, Diana begins behaving violently after disappearing into the forest, forcing her husband Anas to kill her.

results.title: #SKYKING
results.overview: Tells the story of 28-year-old Horizon Air ground service agent Richard “Beebo” Russell, who, to the shock of all who knew him, clocked into work wearing a shirt that said “sky’s no limit,” stole a 33-million-dollar plane, and took off into the skies of the Pacific Northwest embarking on a white-knuckle flight that would come to embody the hopes, dreams, and despair of the American working class, and offer a timely look into the U.S. mental health crisis.

results.title: This Is I
results.overview: Bullied for wanting to be an idol, Kenji finds belonging in a cabaret and help from a trailblazing doctor, emerging onstage as her true self, Ai Haruna.

results.title: ¡Allez!
results.overview: Through the journey of Silvia Sánchez Tosca, this documentary explores the practice of fencing in Tabasco. A portrait of the dedication of an athlete, coach, and academic who has transformed the sport in her region.

results.title: Comedic Genius
results.overview: Comedic genius is a short film about an unfunny highschool student named Dax who wants to become a famous comedian!

results.title: Reckless
results.overview: A former convict on parole must outwit the police to get his share of an old heist.

results.title: Prosecution
results.overview: After surviving a racist attack, state prosecutor Seyo Kim takes her own case to court – confronting both the perpetrators and a justice system that turns a blind eye to right-wing extremism.

results.title: Maa Behen
results.overview: When trouble knocks on her door, a mother and her estranged daughters attempt to cover up a crime in a nosy colony where no secret is safe.

results.title: All About Corinne
results.overview: Corinne Maclou is a background actor who dreams of one day being more than an extra. Confident her breakthrough is right around the corner, she befriends famous actor Sandrine Kiberlain, hoping it will help her achieve her goal.

results.title: House Sitter
results.overview: While house-sitting for the mysterious and wealthy Harold Finch, three friends find themselves hunted by a masked killer. As they fight to survive, chilling clues hidden throughout the home reveal that this suburban nightmare may be part of something far more sinister…

results.title: Under Heaven
results.overview: An experimental documentary about Vermont's Northeast Kingdom and Upper Valley. It highlights the sparseness of the landscape, its isolation and industry, while showing the thread of humanity that lies within.

results.title: Lift
results.overview: Six years after an office elevator accident that claimed many lives, PT Jamsa Land is terrorized again. Linda, the company's public relations staff, is trapped in the elevator and forced to face a mysterious voice from the intercom. Her child is taken hostage, and Linda has no choice but to participate in a dangerous game that slowly reveals the dark secrets of the tragedy six years ago.
